jenna: heads up — CloudNova onboarding. customer reports no API key in their project after SSO flow. ticket 12345. console shows a key created but it's not bound to their project (403 when calling with the key). any quick checks?

onboard-bot: provisioner_event: claim_created id=clm_01Fxyz time=1749998860 -> bind_attempt failed reason=org_mismatch target_org=partner-431

kevin: taking this. can you paste the tenant_id + the claim token and the curl that failed? also need provisioner logs around 1749998860.

jenna: tenant_id: tn-cloudnova-9f
claim_token: eyJhbGciOiJI... (truncated)
failed curl:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJI..." \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/cloudnova/keys
# response
{"error":"forbidden","message":"project access denied"}
```

samir: seen similar. often the claim ends up bound to our partner account when the OIDC external_id collides (we had a duplicate external_id from older test tenants). could be a duplicate mapping in the provisioner DB.

olivia: quick triage of logs: provisioner accepted the claim, then looked up mapping for external_id="cloudnova-sso:acme-oauth" and matched partner-431. That explains why key landed in partner org. Repro steps I used: run OIDC handshake with redirect_uri missing trailing slash -> claim created with external_id normalized differently -> lookup hits wrong row.

kevin: i can reproduce in staging. minimal repro: 1) create OIDC config with redirect_uri "https://app.cloudnova.com/sso" (no slash) 2) initiate SSO, finish flow -> provisioner creates claim with external_id that doesn't canonicalize trailing slash 3) provisioner lookup uses exact match and matches old partner mapping.

kevin: temp workaround: manual rebind via internal API. payload: 
```
POST /internal/provision/rebind
{
  "claim_id": "clm_01Fxyz",
  "target_tenant": "tn-cloudnova-9f",
  "force": true
}
```
returns key_id. after rebind, reissue the API key to customer. will have to do this manually for CloudNova.

jenna: can you run the rebind and confirm? customer is blocked from going live.

kevin: running now. grabbing logs...

onboard-bot: rebind_job started job=rb_20260317_01 by=kevin at=1749999201

kevin: rebind complete. key id=key_0a7b re-associated with tn-cloudnova-9f and permissions restored. quick smoke: curl with new key returns 200 for /v1/projects/cloudnova/keys.

jenna: amazing, thank you. i'll update the customer and mark as escalated.

olivia: mitigation plan: 1) patch provisioner to canonicalize redirect_uri (strip trailing slash) and normalize external_id dedup rules — PR queued, testing now. 2) temporary data fix: run a scan for external_id duplicates and surface suspicious matches (we'll run against last 90 days). 3) operational playbook: when onboard customer reports missing key, check provisioner_event logs, then if bind_target != customer_tenant do rebind flow.

samir: added playbook snippet to the onboard runbook and flagged a postmortem if we see >3 occurrences.

jenna: ETA for patch?

olivia: aiming for patch + deploy in ~2h. if that slips i'll follow up.

jenna: great. i'll tell CloudNova we have a manual fix done and a code fix rolling out. thanks everyone :pray:
